segments.name: Digital asset mining
segments.description: Runs cloud mining, self-mining, mining equipment sales and hosting services for enterprise and individual customers.
segments.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the Company operates in a single operating segment that mainly includes: 1) cloud mining solutions services; 2) self-mining; 3) sale of mining equipment; and 4) hosting services and others.

revenueModel.text: Enterprise and individual customers pay in digital assets or U.S. dollars for cloud mining solutions, self-mining output, mining equipment and hosting services.
